scope: Five additional university options for Avery's existing school-route guide. Existing Stanford, Berkeley, Waterloo and Toronto evidence is unchanged. No private biography, accounts, outreach, registration, paid calls, UI edits or publishing.

report.recommendation: Add Calgary and Alberta as Canadian public-university CS routes, UBC Vancouver as a two-stage Science-to-CS route, and Santa Clara and San Jose State as separate Bay Area possibilities. None is an automatic safety guarantee.
integration_notes: Separate admission eligibility, competitive selection and later program progression. A published minimum is not an offer guarantee.
UBC Vancouver first-year BSc admission does not guarantee a Computer Science specialization. Do not apply its specialization rules to Okanagan.
Santa Clara's Arts and Sciences BS in Computer Science and Engineering-school BS in Computer Science and Engineering are different routes within one private university.
San Jose State is a California public university with major-level impaction and local preference, not a guaranteed fallback. Its BSCS is not the Computer Engineering degree.

Use Canadian-student fee/aid categories for Canadian public universities where applicable. For the US schools, Canadian citizenship alone does not confer California residency or US federal/state aid eligibility.
Show US prices only with academic year, currency, course load and exclusions. Do not turn Alberta's general Arts estimate into a Computing Science quote or a tuition-only figure into an all-in total.

The current UAlberta five-subject high-school admission table could not be fully extracted. Keep its exact subject list as a linked verification item, not a guessed checklist. The May 2026 Computing Science 'n/a' row is about additional course-registration prerequisites, not exemption from general admission requirements.

universities.campus: Vancouver primary CS route; Okanagan BSc is a separately identified campus alternative

universities.admission_route: Apply first to the Vancouver BSc/Faculty of Science. alberta_prerequisites.status: verified from the official Alberta/Vancouver/Science selector's read-only data response
alberta_prerequisites.physics_20_waiver: The selector says Physics 20 may be waived with scores of 86% or higher in senior-level Math and Chemistry.
alberta_prerequisites.general: High-school graduation; minimum 70% in Grade 11 or Grade 12 English or equivalents; at least six Grade 12 academic/non-academic courses recommended, not required. UBC considers academic Grade 11 and Grade 12 grades, with attention to degree-related subjects.
alberta_prerequisites.english: Separate English Language Admission Standard applies; possessing the required ELA course does not by itself settle every language-proficiency case.
alberta_prerequisites.online_course_note: The Canadian-high-school page says distributed-learning courses used for degree requirements need interim grades at 50% completion submitted by March 15 and completion by June 30. Recheck the applicable entry cycle before turning this into a personal deadline.

specialization.eligibility: For Major (0376) Computer Science: SCIE_V 001 OR CPSC_V 107 OR CPSC_V 110 OR 6 transfer credits from a two-course computer-programming sequence whose first course is prerequisite to the second. Faculty promotion requirements also apply.
specialization.selection: These are eligibility requirements, not competitive cutoffs. CS belongs to an umbrella quota; students may select up to two specializations within the CS umbrella. Historical admission averages vary and cannot predict future admission.
specialization.timing: The page inspected October 8, 2026 says specialization applications are closed and will reopen in May 2027. This is current-page context, not a deadline for a future cohort.

universities.campus_difference: UBC Okanagan separately offers a Computer Science BSc in the Irving K. Barber Faculty of Science, with co-op and a client software capstone described. Vancouver's CS umbrella cutoff/selection rules must not be copied onto Okanagan. Okanagan progression rules were not separately audited in this bounded pass.

published_minima: Equivalent of US GPA 3.0 or B average
Three years of college-preparatory mathematics with C- or better
Four years college-preparatory English when English is the school's medium of instruction
Official Grade 9-12 records and final secondary completion date
alberta_prerequisites.english_exemption: The dedicated English-proficiency page exempts applicants with at least three years full-time study at an institution where English is the primary language of instruction. Do not assume exemption from citizenship alone.
alberta_prerequisites.limit: SJSU converts international grades as needed. Minimum 3.0/B does not establish the competitive CS threshold.

universities.minimum_vs_competitive: All SJSU majors are impacted. Applicants are ranked within their chosen major and capacity; local high-school preference is tied to Santa Clara County, not Bay Area aspiration or Canadian citizenship. Fall 2026 CS's historical impaction point index was 3240. That is not a GPA, an Alberta-percent cutoff or a guaranteed Fall 2027 threshold.
universities.testing: The current impaction page explicitly says Fall 2027 SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. The international steps page still contains older encouragement to submit scores for an English exemption; do not treat that as SAT/ACT-based admission selection. Use the dedicated English policy for language requirements.
